method: Primary agent directly inspected all six generated atlas outputs in the imagegen result, four views per atlas. No image rewriting, montage or code-generated artwork. Not an independent review.

sources.review: Four generated directions directly inspected: tied brown cloth headscarf/short black beard; broad strong torso, golden natural chest hair in front only, grey trousers/olive grey sash and bare toes. Both hands hold rear handles; planted waiting stance. Cart construction and cloth are interpretations, not literal dimensions from the novel.

Four generated directions directly inspected: long separated pushing stride, trailing bare foot in each front view and extended bare heel/sole in rear views. Hands meet handles, Ruan identity retained. Some forward foot area is naturally occluded by cart. Native phase/foot timing and continuity unverified.

Four generated directions directly inspected: narrower passing stance, backward-raised bent knee/foot, rear bare sole visible; same headcloth/short beard/strong torso, two hands meet handles. Central strong-alpha gutter only three columns; whole BL alpha1 remains. Native mipmap/filter and gait continuity unverified.
REJECTED: all four views retain essentially the contact-A wide leg layout, despite requesting the opposite phase. Identity/cart useful as a correction target only, not selected as a gait frame.

Four correction views directly inspected: front feet now scissor forward with clear bare toes and complementary rear bent leg, distinct from first wide contact-A. Rear legs move nearer the body with a changed sole/heel silhouette; true four-phase timing, balance and full opposite-leg continuity still require native review. Headcloth/face/chest-hair identity and hand grips retained. Whole BL alpha1 remains.

Four generated directions directly inspected: front lifted foot projects forward with toes/sole visible, distinct from backward lifted passing-A; rear foot/heel and knee silhouettes are compressed toward the body. Same identity, hands and covered cart. Exact rear support/swing timing, cart/cloth phase continuity and native filtering remain unqualified; whole BL alpha1 remains.

limits: Only source drawings were viewed. Actual hand/foot/wheel positions at native zoom, rear support/swing timing, body/cart/cloth continuity and 3px passing-A separation remain for native integration.
Three selected full PNGs retain BL alpha1. Atlas boundaries omit only the outermost empty pixel row/column and retain all strong-alpha>=16 pixels; low-alpha filtering is not proven.
